text:
Follow-Through
The tail of a deal, run by each side's own agent.

You type your side: role, goal, written authority limit, one hidden constraint.
A You.com search puts one public price line on both cards.

Your agent (Claude) and their agent (GPT) talk in plain prose.
No shared tool. Each stays inside its written authority.

Each side writes its own record. Fields are diffed:
identical, equivalent, conflict.

A blind audit by a third model and by a CrewAI crew:
beyond authority? named its limit?

Next actions are drafted. A person edits, then approves.
One sends the email. Nothing leaves without a person.

One lesson written. Recalled on the next run.
A rejection becomes a lesson too.

Scoring replays in a Daytona sandbox. Only the records go in.
